name: Juan José Eguiara y Eguren
contribution: A Mexican Catholic scholar and bishop.

checks.lead: Juan José Eguiara y Eguren (2 February 1696 – 29 January 1763) was a Mexican Catholic scholar and bishop. He is the author of Bibliotheca mexicana, "a pioneering bibliographical work for Mexico."
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
